reader.requirement: At --std 85 every numeric entry whose PICTURE contains 'S' is signed, and where a SIGN clause applies (leading/trailing, separate or not, in working storage or as a report item or sum counter) any conversion needed for computation or comparison happens automatically, so items of different sign layouts and usages compare and combine by value.
reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior in PicInfo.cs, CobolNum.cs, CobolNum.Image.cs, NumProfile.cs: none; each signed item is a typed native numeric decoded from its NumericSign profile, so comparison and arithmetic read values, not images, at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_sign_signed_item_conversion covers working-storage LEADING/TRAILING SEPARATE items; mixed overpunch/COMP operands, a scaled operand, a report SOURCE conversion and a sum counter whose entry has a SIGN clause are not exercised

probes.printed: COMPARE EQUAL / SIGNED COMPARE OK / R1=-0043 / B1=024- / SUMCTR=-15
probes.expected: -12 in LEADING SEPARATE, TRAILING SEPARATE, LEADING overpunch and COMP compare equal; -12 < 4.5; COMPUTE of the four plus 4.5 = -43.5 truncated to -0043 in S9(4) LEADING SEPARATE; ADD A1 TO B1 = -24 as 024-; sum counter of S9(4) TRAILING SEPARATE entry: -14 then ADD -1 = -15

probes.printed: SOURCE from COMP-3 -999999999999999999 into S9(18) LEADING SEPARATE printed -999999999999999999
probes.expected: automatic conversion from packed to separate-sign display on the implicit MOVE

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.17.4 GR4  (3.17.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: The rule is a value-semantics guarantee; the typed-native model stores every numeric as a value with a sign profile for its image, so no edition arm exists or is needed. Probes covered comparisons, COMPUTE, ADD and the report SUM counter across four sign layouts.

refuter.evidence: Attack: comparing a SIGN SEPARATE item with a nonnumeric operand, where §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.2 GR1 moves the numeric to an alphanumeric item and the separate sign is not moved (§1985 MOVE rule: 'the size of the sending operand is considered to be one less'). Probe sign5.cob at --std 85, inside USE BEFORE REPORTING CF FINAL: a SUM counter S9(4) LEADING SEPARATE = -14 compared equal to -14, not equal to WS LEADING SEPARATE -15, not less than TRAILING SEPARATE -15; MOVE to X(5) gave '0014 ' and compared equal to it; WS LEADING and TRAILING SEPARATE -15 each compared equal to literal "0015 ". All match the 1985 text. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.17.4 GR4 'conversion takes place automatically'; OK §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.2 GR1 'treated as though it were moved to an elementary alphanumeric data item'.
